_doc.purpose: Navigation index for doc_style.json + doc_content.txt. Read this file FIRST — the style file is usually too large to read whole.
workflow: 1. scan elements[] here (or grep doc_content.txt) to find the target idx
2. fetch that one entry: jq '.elements[IDX]' doc_style.json
3. any *_ref integer in it -> jq '.xmlStrings[N]' doc_style.json for the verbatim XML
4. full text of the element: grep -A50 '\[idx=IDX\]' doc_content.txt
_doc.row_fields: idx/type/style/anchor always; heading=level, list=numFmt/ilvl, dims=RxC for tables, sdt=in content control, has=[extras present on the full entry]
